text.tspan: A small orange fox carrying a tiny book walks through a sunny
meadow, looking for a peaceful spot, soft watercolor, rounded
shapes. Characters: MIRA: a small young orange fox cub (#e67e22)
with a white chest tuft (#f5f5f0), big amber eyes, fluffy tail,
pink button nose (#f1948a), wearing a tiny red scarf (#c0392b),
friendly worried expression. soft watercolor children's book
illustration, warm muted palette, rounded friendly shapes,
gentle rim lighting, hand-painted paper texture, cozy storybook
mood, no text. palette: cream #f4e1c1, sage #6b8f71, terracotta
mira chest tuft #f5f5f0, mira scarf #c0392b, mira nose #f1948a.
leave the lower third as calm, low-detail negative space for
caption text; keep characters clear of that zone.
